turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
Hey Bestie! Thanks for reaching out to us 🙂

Yes, you can update the shipping address through our Edit Order Portal within 30 minutes of placing a regular order. If your order includes a custom or personalized piece, you have 3 business days to update the address.

Please note that we can’t manually change the address or cancel the order for you. Hope this helps! 💖

Evry Customer Specialist

Thanks so much for reaching out to us!

We totally understand that sometimes plans change, however, once an order is placed, we’re unable to cancel, modify, refund, return, or exchange it due to how quickly our system begins processing. 💻✨

That said, if you just placed your order, you’ve got a 30-minute window to update your shipping address yourself! Just head over to your order dashboard here:

🔗 https://account.evryjewels.com/orders/

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Once an order is placed, we’re unable to modify it, so an item can’t be added after checkout. 💻✨

The 30-minute window applies only to updating the shipping address, not adding items. You’ll need to place a separate order for the additional item.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail: Thanks for getting in touch. If the order has already shipped, it can’t be changed, including adding another item. The 30-minute window is only for updating the shipping address, and changes aren’t available once the order is moving through fulfillment. You’d need to place a separate order for anything else you’d like to purchase 💖

Edit your account information.

If you need to change a specific detail and run into trouble, tell me which one you’re updating.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail: Thanks for checking in. Orders can’t be cancelled once placed, so there isn’t a cancellation refund timeline. The 30-minute window is only for updating the shipping address, not cancelling an order. 💖

turns.q: Can you check whether my latest order can still be modified?
turns.replyTail: Thanks for getting in touch. Please send your order number, the email address used at checkout, and your phone number so I can check whether the order can still be modified.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail: Thanks for checking. Separate orders can’t be combined into one shipment after they’re placed. Orders can’t be modified after checkout, so each order will remain separate. If you’d like additional items, you’ll need to place a separate order. 💖

turns.q: Can I change the payment method on my order?
turns.replyTail: We’re unable to change the payment method once an order has been placed. If you need to use a different payment method, you’ll need to place a new order with the preferred method. 💖

turns.replyTail: Thanks for checking. If you mean changing the payment method on this existing order, that change can’t be made, so there won’t be a confirmation email for it. You’d need to place a new order using your preferred payment method. 💖
